questions.prompt: Compare Thomson's plum-pudding model with Rutherford's nuclear model. Give three scientific differences.

accepted: In the plum-pudding model positive charge was spread throughout the atom, while the nuclear model concentrated positive charge in a nucleus. stimulus.text: Experiment: beam of positive alpha particles → very thin gold foil → surrounding detector.
